# M2M AURA

> M2M AURA is an AI-powered Digital Twin platform for sovereign data centres. It monitors PUE, GPU utilization, thermals, carbon emissions, and compliance in real time.

M2M AURA helps operators of Sovereign AI data centres design, simulate, and operate their facilities through a unified Digital Twin. The platform provides telemetry and analytics grounded in industry standards (Uptime Institute, ASHRAE TC 9.9, IEA), agent orchestration, blueprint-driven configuration, and Quebec/Canadian data sovereignty controls.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Platform overview, features, integrations, and use cases for the Sovereign AI Data Centre Digital Twin.
- [Onboarding](/onboarding): Guided 4-step questionnaire to configure a new Digital Twin for your facility.
- [Sign In](/login): Access the M2M AURA studio for existing customers.
